record.question: A 4-bar mechanism with all revolute pairs has link lengths lf = 20 mm (fixed link), lin = 40 (input link), lco=50 mm (coupler link) and lout= 60 mm (output link). Which one of the following statements is true about the input and output links?
options: Both links can execute full circular motion
Both links cannot execute full circular motion
Only the output link cannot execute full circular motion
Only the input link cannot execute full circular motion
